event.description: Share one head-local attention output map across depth blocks
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 2830 parameters at 99.9800%, a +0.98 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0043, MQA with independent head-local output maps at 3038 parameters and 99.91%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0057, block-diagonal Q projections at 2688 parameters and 0.01%; prior attempts in this family: 12. Hypothesis: the accepted head-local output organization suggests that one output map may be redundant across depth, so share only head 0's 7x7 post-attention output map between the two blocks while keeping both causal self-attention applications, both Q/KV projections, and head 1's map independent. This removes 49 parameters for a target of 2781. It is more informative than the nearest untested cross-layer Q or KV tie because it isolates redundancy in the already head-local post-attention path without constraining attention scores or values. Keep the retained d14/h2/L2 MQA, ff23 with one within-block tied hidden unit shared across blocks, rank8 positions, two final group scales, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
